issue.title: Unable to set script.allowed_contexts in elasticsearch.yml

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`):
5.5.3

**Plugins installed**: []
x-pack

**JVM version** (`java -version`):
1.8.0_60

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

This is similar to the issue reported [here](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/24830).  

**Steps to reproduce**:

 1.  Add the following setting to elasticsearch.yml file per [documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/5.5/modules-scripting-security.html#allowed-script-contexts-setting)

```script.allowed_contexts: search, update```

 2. Start elasticsearch
 3. ES terminates with the following error:
